title: Dimension is invariant under extension of scalars of fields
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space. Then $K\otimes_kV$ is a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space and $\dim_K(K\otimes_kV)=\dim_kV$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension].
